senses.gloss: pr. n. pl.Beth Sharye, Be Sharye, a valley in which Beth Shean was situated.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 98:17">Gen. R. s. 98</cite> <he>רובצת תחת</he> … <he>בבית הש׳</he> ‘lying deep’ (<cite ref="Genesis 49:25">Gen. XLIX, 25</cite>), that is Beth Shean in Beth ha-Sharye.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 9:3:6">Y. Kil. IX, 32ᵇ</cite> top; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 12:3:6">Y. Keth. XII, 35ᵃ</cite> <he>ואחתוניה בי ש׳</he> and they carried him down (for burial) to Be Sh.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 3:5:12">Y. M. Kat. III, 82ᶜ</cite> top <he>הרי שמוליכין … דקברין בבית ש׳</he> if they carry the body from place to place, as for instance those who bury their dead in Beth Sh.
